blocks.text: II. Examination Techniques (Updated 06/26/2024)
blocks.html: II. Examination Techniques (Updated 06/26/2024)

blocks.text: Anus exam (visual anal or digital rectal exam [DRE]) is not required unless indicated by past medical history (PMH) or symptoms. It may be performed at the discretion of the examiner and applicant.
